title: Apple Music retry is not blocked by a timed-out queue request
acceptance: When setQueue times out in apple-music-adapter.ts, the pending-queue lock for that instance no longer blocks the next prepare, so Retry playback can try again without a page reload.
A test covers: setQueue never settles, prepare times out, the next prepare reaches setQueue instead of 'still finishing a previous queue request'.
nextAction: Owner moved to Ready on 2026-10-29 as Lane A. Draft PR #656 (fix/rf-124-resume-in-place) already holds the work: the lane claims this record In progress on that PR at start. Rebase #656 onto main, drop its RF-124 and RF-29 edits (both Done on main), finalize RF-123 and its resume-in-place work in its own record(s), then ask for owner approval. evidence.summary: Owner iPhone Safari 2026-10-28: after a hung setQueue, Retry playback and a fresh Start both showed 'The Apple Music player is still finishing a previous queue request for "Break Stuff"'. pendingQueueGenerations is cleared only in the setQueue promise's finally, which never runs when MusicKit never settles.
Open PR carrying the RF-123 lock fix and resume in place; needs a rebase after #657 merged (d81c0fc).
Owner instruction in session, 2026-10-29: "Yes move RF-123 and RF-132 to Ready and brief them as Lane A and Lane B after start-session". RF-123 is Lane A (Apple playback, Phase 1).
